brand.name: Underworld Writer
brand.tagline: Build the story. Expose the truth. Ship what matters.
brand.supportingLine: Narrative engine · Editorial tooling · Podcast creation · Real impact

designSystem.name: Neon Underworld Release Changelog
designSystem.purpose: Canonical repository-owned visual language for changelog, release-note, README hero, Open Graph, and social release graphics.
visualLanguage: cinematic black and void-purple cavern environment
high-energy magenta portal or vertical light beam on the right
stitched voodoo-doll mascot as the recurring Underworld Writer character
large left-aligned UNDERWORLD WRITER wordmark with WRITER in magenta
release/version treatment directly beneath the product descriptor
feature cards across the lower third
repository identity and changelog metadata in a dark footer
strong contrast zones behind every text block

typography.display: Arial Black, Impact, or equivalent heavy geometric sans-serif
rules: UNDERWORLD must remain white or ghost-white and WRITER must use the magenta accent.
FUSED GAMING / OPEN SOURCE uses tracked uppercase magenta metadata styling.
Version and RELEASE form one visual row and remain secondary to the product wordmark.
Never place text directly on a high-detail cavern or mascot region without a dark contrast layer.

zones.features: lower-third full width with four to six cards
zones.footer: bottom full-width repository and changelog metadata strip

mascot.subject: stitched voodoo doll
mascot.treatment: cloth/rag-doll silhouette with visible seams, button or stitched eye, pins, and magenta rim light
mascot.rule: The repository design may stylize the CC0 voodoo-doll motif, but the result must stay clearly recognizable as the recurring Underworld Writer mascot.

background.focalLight: vertical neon-magenta portal or energy beam on the right
background.readability: dark overlays and negative space must preserve text contrast

featureCards.style: dark translucent cards with thin blue-violet borders and magenta line icons
featureCards.contentRule: Card copy must be derived from current CHANGELOG/release highlights rather than hard-coded historical claims.

openGraph.strategy: render the full Neon Underworld Release Changelog composition

readmeHero.strategy: use the canonical Open Graph SVG directly at the top of README.md

githubSocial.strategy: adapt the same composition without cropping the wordmark, mascot, release row, or footer

wideHeader.strategy: preserve left wordmark/right mascot split and reduce feature-card height before removing protected regions

square.strategy: stack brand/release above scene and cards; never center-crop the 1200x630 composition

generation.rendererOwnership: external dependency; do not modify Rock-Hardened to implement repository-specific styling
rules: Rock-Hardened supplies changelog/release data; Underworld Writer owns this visual design contract.
Future agents must update this repository contract/template rather than changing Rock-Hardened for Underworld Writer-specific styling.
Generated release SVGs are derivative output and must remain reproducible from repository release data and this contract.
A human preview is required before a materially new composition replaces the canonical release-art style.

requirements: Read this file before generating Underworld Writer release artwork.
Use the Neon Underworld Release Changelog composition; do not fall back to generic dashboard or card-only artwork.
Keep the voodoo-doll mascot, magenta cavern/portal scene, product wordmark, release row, feature-card strip, and footer hierarchy.
Populate feature cards from the current release rather than blindly copying old release text.
Maintain WCAG-oriented high contrast for all essential text.
Never modify the Rock-Hardened package solely to change Underworld Writer visual styling.
